craft_notes: Sthāyin: charter — seats, counting, Kālī (owner reviews first-verse of chapter). Sanskrit-first: kramākramakalana kept as rank-and-off; Kālī named. Rows: catalogue then doctrine. Rejected: smoothing rank/off-rank — killed: sequence-non-sequence is the doctrine. Read aloud: decree roll.

lines: Called by the seat-fixing word: three seats —
breath-wind, frame, without — breath's rule first.
its count, in rank and off, is time —
gleaming in the Highest alone, the God's might Kālī;
sundered, its show in rank and off is breath-sway.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa eva sthānaprakalpanaśabdena uktaḥ tatra tridhā sthānaṃ prāṇavāyuḥ śarīraṃ bāhyaṃ ca tatra prāṇe tāvat vidhiḥ sarvaḥ asau vakṣyamāṇaḥ adhvā prāṇasthaḥ kalyate tasya kramākramakalanaiva kālaḥ sa ca parameśvara eva antarbhāti tadbhāsanaṃ ca devasya kālī nāma śaktiḥ bhedena tu tadābhāsanaṃ kramākramayoḥ prāṇavṛttiḥ
